bias: A pretty weird day ahead of FOMC. Shorts triggered early overnight until a LBAF of 7703-7704 set the ES low in the Euro session (NQ held 269-303 and reclaimed 380-436). The opening drive higher was stiffly rejected — a LAAF of the 3-day balance on ES — and the build was cleanly bearish until 7712-7717 held. Then the entire book instantly changed and buyers chased: the upside break of the 3-day range resolved all the way to the key weekly 7769-7772 before balancing (speculation about war/Israeli-election news). Markets park in a high-volume node into major events: NQ sits at the upper edge of its YTD HVN just above YTD VPOC; ES's high was YTD VPOC. 'I still believe ES 7815-7820 and NQ 30210-30237 matter most coming out of tomorrow.'
wildcard: FOMC — he generally doesn't do setups ahead of it; these rotational trades will likely play out overnight or early. Crazy things happen on FOMC: a 1-minute close above 7815-7820 doesn't mean new highs, flipping it to firm support over hours/days should. Need to see the reaction to the entire press conference and even the next day — the last three FOMCs closed near their lows and rallied all night. Bulls own the short-term trend; manage expectations on shorts; 'while inside a prior day's range, the bid can turn on at a moment's notice.' Inside week so far inside a multi-week balance — the higher we go the more likely fresh sellers present. Daily adds: ES 7886-7888, 7861-7864, 7750-7751 (LBAF monitor), 7726-7728, 7697-7699, 7658-7659; NQ 30440-30454 (failed-reclaim monitor), 29569-29583, 29194-29220, 29089-29102.
